technology_name: Coconut Residue Dietary Fiber Recovery Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for better utilization of industrial by-products from the virgin coconut oil industry.
description: A process for the recovery of high-value dietary fiber from spent coconut residue, a by-product of the virgin coconut oil industry. The process involves oil removal and pre-treatment operations to produce an enriched dietary fiber and protein product using extraction units and jacketed vessels.
applications: • Processing of industrial virgin coconut oil by-products • Manufacturing of high-value dietary fiber supplements • Production of enriched protein food additives • Formulation of functional food ingredients from agricultural waste
